entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number?

Thank you, Sarah. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Urban Commuter Helmet. To make sure I'm documenting this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The color is wrong. I don't like it.
I understand. The product color wasn't what you were hoping for. I can see you've had the helmet for about 37 days. Is the box unopened?
Yes, the box is unopened. Haven't even looked at it.
Okay, thank you for confirming. And Sarah, I also see that you're a VIP member with us. We really appreciate your business. Let me just check the policy on that item for you.

Alright, I've confirmed it. Your helmet is a standard item, and our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the window for a full refund. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
So I just send it back?

That's right. I'm emailing a prepaid return label to you as we speak. You can just print that out and attach it to the original package. And as a small thank you for being a VIP, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for your next purchase.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Okay. Thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
